item.title: Cursor Pro vs Pro Plus: Which Plan Is Right for You in 2026?
item.description: Cursor crossed $2 billion in ARR by February 2026 with a $29.3 billion valuation, which means Anysphere is not a startup making pricing decisions on a napkin — these tiers are engineered for specific customer segments. The distance between Pro and Pro Plus is not just $20 per user per month. It is parallel agent architecture, a doubled context window, Figma-native Design Mode, and the enterprise compliance stack that procurement teams require before signing a purchase order. This article works through every substantive difference so you can make the decision in under ten minutes without reading marketing copy.
